_read_me: Copy this file to config.json and replace the values. Everything is optional: a missing section simply removes its section from the dashboard.
_fuseau: Optional: the time zone that cuts the days, in IANA form (Europe/Paris, America/Montreal…). Absent, the machine's own zone is used.

sites._classement: Optional: a script that writes a CSV ip,type,source,user_agent. Without it, a fallback classifier recognises robots by their user-agent.
sites._page_surveillee: Optional: a page you want to know whether indexing robots visit. The dashboard warns you when a crawler visits the site without ever opening that one.

appstore._cle: App Store Connect key with the Sales role. The .p8 must sit next to the .env file, named AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8. It never leaves the machine.

_mastodon: One object per account: { "compte": "@you", "instance": "https://your.instance" }. Without "fichier", the account is read through the instance's public API, with no token. Left empty, the section disappears.
